feed_summary: In Booz Allen’s isolated OT lab, AI models met every objective across eight scenarios and reached an industrial control network from a perimeter compromise in just over 16 minutes. The post AI Agents Navigate Unfamiliar OT Systems and Move Equipment in Minutes, Booz Allen Finds appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: AI Agents Navigate Unfamiliar OT Systems and Move Equipment in Minutes, Booz Allen Finds
